limitations: Digital geometry and rule simulations only; no physical print, fit, durability or human enjoyment claim.
The twelve-round rules were simulated; six- and eighteen-round variants were not separately simulated.
Five-player synchronized policies remain a documented balance concern.
Recommended age 8+ and 20-40 minute duration are estimates, not measured human-use results.
Assembly requires printed pieces, opaque paper or card, scissors, a pencil and a permanent marker.
summary: Steer two shared currents together, carry your rivals into crowded harbors, and cross lanes for the next surprise. A simultaneous tabletop game for family evenings.
title: Crosscurrent
what_arrives: Ready-to-print files for a shore, two rotating carriers and ten numbered boats: thirteen printed pieces from eight unique files.
Printable sheets for twenty-five choice cards and a score sheet.
Six-page illustrated owner guide, with printing and assembly notes supplied separately.
